resolution: Synchronized user Active Directory account with the ERP database and forced a password reset.

title: Zoom audio loop issues
description: I am experiencing an audio feedback loop whenever I join a meeting on Zoom version 5.17. I am using a Jabra Evolve2 headset on a Dell Latitude 7440. It makes it impossible to conduct client calls.
resolution: Updated the Jabra firmware and adjusted the audio input/output settings in Zoom to specifically select the headset rather than the system default.

title: Outlook missing search results
description: Outlook search is acting up again. It is not showing any emails received after last Tuesday. I have tried rebuilding the index via Windows Search Options, but that didn't help. Is there a fix for this?
resolution: Repaired the Outlook data file (.ost) using the SCANPST.EXE utility and restarted the Windows Search service.

title: Cannot export reports in PowerBI
description: I keep getting a 'Generic OLEDB error' when trying to export a report to PDF. I'm using the latest PowerBI desktop version. I need this fixed ASAP as the board meeting is in an hour.
resolution: Updated the OLEDB drivers and verified permissions on the target network drive destination.

title: VPN connection drops in Cisco AnyConnect
description: My VPN keeps dropping every 15 minutes while I'm using the proprietary internal web app. The console log shows 'DTLS tunnel disconnected'. Can you fix this? It's really affecting my workflow.
resolution: Disabled the 'Block connections to untrusted servers' setting in the Cisco AnyConnect profile and updated the client to the latest stable release.

title: VS Code plugin error
description: The Python extension for VS Code is throwing an error: 'Command 'python.setInterpreter' not found'. This happened right after the recent VS Code update to version 1.88. Any ideas?
resolution: Uninstalled and reinstalled the Python extension, then re-indexed the virtual environment path.

title: Chrome plugin broken
description: The internal password manager extension is greyed out. It won't let me click the icon to sign in. It was working yesterday just fine.
resolution: Updated Chrome to the latest version, which resolved an incompatibility issue with the current extension manifest v3.

title: AutoCAD license error
description: Autocad is giving me a license error code 1.1.0 every time I launch it. It says it cannot connect to the license server on the network. I've checked my connection and I am definitely connected to the office LAN.
resolution: Refreshed the license lease via the Autodesk Desktop Licensing Service and cleared the local login cache.
